name: dynasty-dealer
description: Dynasty fantasy football trade values, trade grades, rankings and real-trade prices, built from real Sleeper trades blended with community votes. Grade a trade, look up what players and rookie picks are worth in Superflex or 1QB, pull dynasty rankings, or see what a player or pick actually fetched in recent trades. Works without an account; sign in to use what your Dynasty Dealer plan includes. All tools are read-only.
